_doc: H12 Patrón (docs/gdd/04d_otras_clases.md 4.22.4.1-2, 4.22.4.6): the farmer's Granja, with housing. field_a..field_d: the fields (stations of kind field that work as "field": the recipes farm_plow, farm_sow_wheat, farm_harvest; their state in buildings[b].fields, sim/farm/fields.gd); pen: the corral (the animals are items of its storage, up to pen_capacity, +4 with the upgrade; sim/farm/herds.gd); fields: the speed of field work by constitution (Fields.speed). upkeep 15 (the GDD's reckoning of 4.22.8) [balance]. No counter: the wheat, the wool and the animals go to the market's stalls and the board's contracts.
